question: Should `/workspace` become a supported compatibility alias for the default persisted workspace in gateway and CLI containers, or remain sandbox-only terminology?
rationale: Current main intentionally documents separate runtime and sandbox locations; a new alias changes the supported path contract and can confuse custom-workspace and sandbox behavior even if the code change is small.

options.title: Keep paths distinct
options.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as the runtime path and keep `/workspace` reserved for sandbox workspaces, with docs clarifying the distinction where users encounter it.

options.title: Support a runtime alias
options.body: Add `/workspace` as a documented compatibility alias for the default Docker/Podman runtime workspace and cover all supported launch paths with smoke and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep paths distinct
recommendation.body: Retain `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` as the runtime path and keep `/workspace` reserved for sandbox workspaces, with docs clarifying the distinction where users encounter it.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review and feature history connect this decision to the shared container and sandbox boundary.
